name: Chatlivo Live Chat & AI Chatbot
author: chatlivo

sections.description:
Boost your website engagement and turn visitors into customers with live chat, AI chatbot flows, and WhatsApp integration. Chatlivo helps growing businesses connect with customers the moment they land on your site — free to start, no credit card required.
Elevate Your Customer Conversations
We offer everything you need to convert visitors into customers: live chat, WhatsApp integration, and no-code chatbot flows — all from a single, unified inbox. Real-time messaging that never drops a conversation, even when your agent reconnects after going offline.

Why Choose Chatlivo?

💬 Chat and Connect
The widget loads in under 20KB, so no lag or clutter is slowing your site down. No iframe either — it just works.

📱WhatsApp on the Free Plan
Most competitors lock WhatsApp behind a paid tier. We didn’t think that made sense, so WhatsApp Business integration is included from day one, even if you never upgrade.

📊 Real Conversation History
Free plan users get 14 days of chat history. Upgrade to a paid tier, and that stretches to 90+ days, so context on a returning customer never gets lost.

🔒 GDPR Compliant
Your data is handled under full GDPR compliance, which means you can run live chat with confidence, no matter where your customers are located.

What Can Chatlivo Do?

Live Chat
Talk to your website visitors as they’re browsing — it feels closer to a real conversation than a support ticket.

WhatsApp Integration
WhatsApp conversations land in the same dashboard as your website chats. One inbox, not two separate tools to check.

Multi-Agent Dashboard
See who’s online, assign conversations, and track what’s open, resolved, or pending across your whole team.

Lead Generation
The chatbot grabs a visitor’s name and email before handing them off to a live agent, so you’re not starting from zero.

Mobile-Ready
The widget adjusts cleanly whether someone’s on their laptop or scrolling on their phone.

Ready to take your online presence to new heights? Experience the difference with Chatlivo today and witness firsthand what we can do for your business!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the chatlivo folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen. You’ll be taken to the Chatlivo setup screen.
  3. Create a free account (verify the OTP emailed to you) or log in.
  4. The chat widget script is added to your site’s head automatically.
sections.faq:
How can Chatlivo benefit my website?

Chatlivo lets you connect with visitors the moment they land on your site through live chat, and reach them on WhatsApp — all from one dashboard. The free plan includes both channels, so you can start converting visitors without any upfront cost.

What’s the cost of Chatlivo?

Chatlivo has a free plan (1 agent, 25 conversations/month, WhatsApp + live chat, 14-day history). The Pro plan is $12/month ($10/month billed annually) with unlimited agents and conversations. The Business plan is $24/month ($20/month billed annually) with white-label options and advanced analytics.

How can you integrate Chatlivo with your website?

Install the Chatlivo plugin from WordPress.org, activate it, and connect your account from the plugin settings in your WordPress admin dashboard. The widget appears automatically on your site via a single script — no coding required.

Do you have a mobile app?

The mobile apps for iOS and Android are coming soon. Today, the dashboard is fully accessible from any mobile browser.

Does Chatlivo support WhatsApp?

Yes — WhatsApp Business API integration is included even on the free plan. Conversations from WhatsApp appear in the same dashboard as your website live chats.

Which languages does the Chatlivo dashboard support?

The dashboard currently supports English and Spanish; more languages are coming soon.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Sign up or log in to Chatlivo from the WordPress dashboard, with email OTP verification.
  • One-click connection: the widget script is fetched from the Chatlivo API and added to the site’s head (async).
  • Domain-aware: one Chatlivo account supports one website, with a guided transfer screen when the account is connected to another site.
  • Activate/deactivate the chat, single sign-on links into the Chatlivo dashboard, and full cleanup on uninstall.
  • Session token stored encrypted at rest.
